Laura Jones

Democratic candidate for U.S. Representative, District 8, Harris County, Texas · Open seat

Businesswoman; licensed real estate agent and owner of a cleaning business; community activist

Laura Jones is a Houston-area Democrat and former chair of the San Jacinto County Democratic Party. She was the Democratic nominee for Texas' 8th Congressional District in 2020, 2022 and 2024, and lost each general election. She beat Keith Coleman in the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Jessica Hart Steinmann on November 3, 2026, for a seat that has no incumbent running.

Where Jones stands

Cost of living / affordability
Names lowering the cost of groceries, childcare and housing as a top priority.
Wages
Says she will fight for a living wage and argues that higher wages are needed so families can keep up with growth in Texas.
Health care
Supports Medicare for All.
Social Security
Lists protecting Social Security among her top priorities.
Voting access
Lists protecting voting access among her top priorities.
Immigration
Says she would end what she calls abusive immigration detention practices, with strict oversight and accountability.
Growth and housing
Supports more affordable housing supply and cutting red tape for housing, while protecting renters and homeowners from being priced out. Also supports infrastructure investment that keeps pace with population growth.
Constituent services in redrawn district
Says she will show up across the new district and keep her office accessible, and will seek federal resources based on need, not politics.

Background

  • Democratic nominee, U.S. House Texas District 8: 2020, 2022, 2024 (lost general elections; 31.8% in 2024)
  • Won the Democratic primary for TX-8 on March 3, 2026, defeating Keith Coleman
  • Former chair, San Jacinto County Democratic Party
  • Licensed real estate agent, Executive Texas Realty (2018–present)
  • Business owner, Executive Cleaning Consultants (2018–present)
  • Business owner, Chandelier Cleaning Company (2009–2017)

In the news

  • Cast a protest vote against partisan gerrymandering in these three open congressional races | Endorsement Houston Chronicle, October 15, 2026

Also running for U.S. Representative, District 8

  • Jessica Hart Steinmann Republican
